notes:
{有給|ゆうきゅう} is short for ⟦{有給休暇|ゆうきゅうきゅうか}→有給休暇：06996_yuukyuukyuuka⟧ (paid vacation/leave). It refers to paid time off from work.

Full form: ⟦{有給休暇|ゆうきゅうきゅうか}→有給休暇：06996_yuukyuukyuuka⟧

Common expressions:
- {有給|ゆうきゅう}を⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (take paid leave)
- {有給|ゆうきゅう}を⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ (use paid leave)
- {有給|ゆうきゅう}⟦{消化|しょうか}→消化：04200_shouka⟧ (using up paid leave)
- {有給|ゆうきゅう}⟦{残日数|ざんにっすう}→残日数：noentry⟧ (remaining paid leave days)

Cultural note:
Japanese workers often hesitate to use their paid leave due to workplace culture. Recent labor laws require companies to ensure employees take at least 5 days of paid leave annually.
